description: Last Stand: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: {station} is the last {client} position in {system} and {enemy} is coming with everything. The {flagship} will hold as long as it can. Relief will not come for ten minutes. Hold the line, protect the {flagship} and keep the {station} alive.
{client} has told the fleet to hold {system}. That is not a decision made lightly. Ten minutes of fighting and then, perhaps, help. The {flagship} will not leave.
No retreat. The {flagship} holds the station and you hold the {flagship}. {enemy} will not take {system} while you are alive.
success: The relief fleet arrives with nothing to do but pick up the pieces. {client} pays {captain} the full fee and names the engagement after the station.
Ten minutes pass and relief arrives. {client} pays and orders the {flagship} to dock for months.
The line held. {client} pays and mentions a medal, then forgets it.
failure: The {flagship} falls and the station follows. {client} pays only the families of the dead.
{system} is lost. {client} pays nothing and begins the withdrawal.
radio-station: All hands, this is the {flagship}. We are holding. We have ten minutes of bad odds.
{flagship} here. Fighters, you have the space. Ships, hold fire until they come into range.
This is the station. Defence grid active. We are with you.
radio-first: First wave. Eight fighters and four gunships. Break them before they reach the {flagship}.
Enemy fighters from ahead. They are going for the {flagship}.
radio-second: Two cruisers coming in on the left. Heavy guns. Do not let them settle.
{enemy} cruisers in range. They will pound the {flagship} if you let them.
Cruisers. Two. The station will not last long if they are left alone.
radio-carrier: Carrier overhead. The {target}. It is launching more.
Jump flash. It is the {target}, with its wing already out.
The {target} is here. This is their main strike.
radio-relief: Relief is here! {client} fleet, jumping in. Hold for another minute!
This is the relief column. We heard. We are late. We are here.
All ships, friendly fleet inbound. Do not shoot the ones with our colours.
